items.title: The geometric fibre functor on the small etale site is the stalk at a point of the site
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter etale-cohomology.tex, section on the stalk at a geometric point

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma exhibits the geometric fibre functor U -> |U_{sbar}| on the small etale site as the stalk functor at a point of the site, and states that this point exists at all (statement lines 3372-3387). The work is to check the three conditions in the criterion for a point of a site: singletonness, compatibility with fibre products and surjectivity on coverings, the last of which is not formal because it needs the lifting of geometric points along an etale covering (proof lines 3399-3404). Once that is done, the two stalk functors are compared directly as colimits. The claim is H2: a criterion check with two cited inputs.
